title: Coefficients of a low-degree polynomial
statement: Let $n$ and $\ell$ be natural numbers, and assign a coefficient in $\mathbb F_2$ to each subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ of size at most $\ell$. Form the Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube by summing each assigned coefficient times the corresponding coordinate monomial. Its algebraic normal form coefficient at each subset is the assigned coefficient when the subset has size at most $\ell$, and is $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A coefficient in $\mathbb F_2$ is assigned to every coordinate subset of size at most $\ell$
